reader.requirement: At --std 85 the OPTIONAL phrase of an indexed file's SELECT has effect only for OPEN INPUT, I-O and EXTEND: an absent OPTIONAL file opens successfully (05; I-O and EXTEND create it; INPUT leaves it not present, so a random READ or START is an invalid key 23 and a sequential READ an at end 10), OUTPUT is unaffected, and an absent file without OPTIONAL fails OPEN INPUT, I-O or EXTEND with 35.
reader.edition-search: grep CobolVersion|Edition|DialectBehavior over KeyedConnector.cs and IndexedConnector.cs (only IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd and IndexedDuplicateKeyStatusSequentialOnly, neither on OPTIONAL); FileControlBinder sets FileModel.Optional from grp.OPTIONAL() with no edition test; the edition number passed to FileRegisterIndexed reaches only those DialectBehavior gates.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf19_03 covers sequential access in all four open modes and the non-optional INPUT 35; not covered: random and dynamic access (READ by key, START on an absent optional file), OPEN I-O / EXTEND of an absent non-optional file, the statement after the failed OPEN, an OPTIONAL file that is present

probes.printed: ORN OPEN 05 / ORN READ INVALID 23 (random) / ODY OPEN 05 / ODY START INVALID 23 (dynamic)
probes.expected: 05 on OPEN INPUT of an absent optional file; 23 for a random READ or START (§1985:IX.1.3.4 GRL2.3 c 2)

probes.printed: RIO OPEN I-O 35 / RIO READ AFTER FAILED OPEN 47 / REX OPEN EXTEND 35
probes.expected: a non-optional absent file: 35 for I-O and EXTEND; READ after the failed OPEN: 47

probes.printed: OPR OPEN PRESENT 00 / OPR READ 00 P001 / OPR OPEN EXTEND PRESENT 00
probes.expected: an OPTIONAL file that is present opens normally (00)

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.2.3.4 GR4  (2.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: KeyedConnector.OpenCore takes IsOptional only on the INPUT and I-O/EXTEND arms, and OUTPUT creates the file whatever the phrase says. The witness and the probe match the 1985 text in every access mode.

refuter.evidence: r4b_opt.cob at --std 85: OPTIONAL absent file OPEN INPUT then sequential READ -> OX FIRST READ AT END 10; OPEN INPUT 05, START -> 23, READ after the failed START -> 46 (§1985 I-O status 46 case 1); CLOSE 00; then a NON-optional SELECT of the same ASSIGN name OPEN INPUT -> 35 (OPEN INPUT of an absent optional file did not create it); OPTIONAL file OPEN OUTPUT while absent -> 00 (not 05: OPTIONAL has no effect on OUTPUT), then present on reopen -> 00; OPTIONAL OPEN EXTEND absent -> 05, WRITE 00, reopen INPUT 00 and READ 00 E001 (file created per GR15); OPTIONAL OPEN I-O absent (dynamic) -> 05, READ by key 23, READ NEXT after it 46, WRITE 00, reopen and READ 00 I001. cite.py: OK §1985:IX.2.3.4 GR4; OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR15 (EXTEND or I-O creates the file); OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR9.
